latest_news.headline: Hormuz shipping still heavily restricted
latest_news.text: Reuters: most Strait of Hormuz shipping remained at a standstill despite U.S. pledge to help free ships; tanker reported hit by unknown projectiles.

latest_news.headline: Iran sets vessel-transit mechanism
latest_news.text: Reuters: Iran set up a new mechanism to manage vessel transit through Hormuz as U.S./Bahrain pushed UN-backed maritime action.

latest_news.headline: Iran nuclear timeline unchanged, access unresolved
latest_news.text: Reuters: U.S. intelligence sees limited new damage and breakout timing around nine months to one year; IAEA verification gaps remain unresolved.

latest_news.headline: Israel strikes Beirut despite Lebanon pause
latest_news.text: DW: Israel struck Beirut for the first time since the Lebanon ceasefire, saying it targeted a Hezbollah Radwan commander.

latest_news.headline: Rubio says Lebanon peace possible but Hezbollah obstacle remains
latest_news.text: Reuters-linked briefing: U.S. officials describe an Israel-Lebanon peace deal as achievable while identifying Hezbollah as the central blocker.

latest_news.headline: Rival Victory Day ceasefires carry threat risk
latest_news.text: Reuters: Putin and Zelenskiy proclaimed rival ceasefires around Russia’s Victory Day; Moscow warned of mass Kyiv strikes if its pause is violated.

latest_news.headline: Russia-NATO risk coupled to Ukraine pause threats
latest_news.text: Reuters/NATO context: short ceasefire threats and prior Oreshnik/Belarus signaling keep direct Russia-NATO risk critical, though no new strategic-alert shift appeared.

latest_news.headline: Taiwan tops agenda for Trump-Xi summit
latest_news.text: Reuters: Xi is expected to put Taiwan at the top of the agenda for Trump’s Beijing trip, amid prior blockade/live-fire drill context.

latest_news.headline: DPRK April missile tests remain residual risk
latest_news.text: Reuters/Al Jazeera: Kim oversaw ballistic missile tests with cluster and fragmentation warheads in April; no fresher launch confirmed in this pulse.

latest_news.headline: Afghan-Pakistan ceasefire strained again
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera: Kabul accused Pakistan of killing civilians in another cross-border incident after China-mediated ceasefire talks.
